Lilith Widget 0.1.7
SKSE energy / level bar for Children of Lilith - Succubus of Skyrim 5.2.0, without iWant Widgets.

Nexus:       https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/191060
Source code: https://github.com/StinkyPumpkin/Lilith-Widget
This build:  https://github.com/StinkyPumpkin/Lilith-Widget/tree/v0.1.7

INSTALL
- Install after Children of Lilith so its ESP and script are overwritten.
- Then remove iWant Widgets and iWant Widgets.esl.
- Needs SKSE, Address Library and SKSE Menu Framework.
